steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen from the Events flow.
Open the buyer's Events list before creating the eRFX project.
Verify the Events list rendered with its Create Event control and no error.
Set the required project title.
Replace the default Auction stage with Technical Stage and RFQ.
Verify the create screen contains exactly the Technical and RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the specified product with quantity 10 through the Items flow.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Set and save the Technical Stage duration to 30 minutes.
Configure the RFQ stage.
Apply the available RFQ pricing template.
Verify an RFQ template was applied.
Add the specified product with quantity 10 through the Items flow.
Populate the RFQ pricing sheet so it is ready for scheduling and publishing.
Enter the requested delivery location in the line-item sheet.
Verify the requested delivery location was retained.
Verify the requested quantity is 10.
Set and save the RFQ stage duration to 60 minutes.
Invite exactly two vendors from the product's QA vendor pool, without inventing supplier names.
Publish the completed Technical + RFQ eRFX project and confirm the publish flow.
Verify the browser reached the published project page.
Verify the published project shows the Project Details tab.
Verify the published project shows the Technical Stage tab.
Verify the published project shows the RFQ tab.
Verify the published project shows the Master QCS tab.
